confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on five price-check web searches. The results were search-summary snippets of cost-of-living sites and menus, not pages I read directly. They reported a mid-range meal for two of about $24 (range 17-40) and an inexpensive meal of about $2.50-3. Cappuccino prices ran about $1.67-2.50. Local draft beer averaged about $1 ($0.50 at happy hour, up to about $2 in tourist bars). Cocktail and wine had no aggregate index. They rest on sparse venue listings (cocktails $3.50-7, hotel bars $5-10; wine about $4 a glass) and a roughly 3-4x local-beer relationship, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Siem Reap's budget market and July green-season softness. I did not search or inspect any booking pages or listings, so they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Siem Reap-specific figures were used where found. For cocktail, wine and accommodation the basis is the local beer price relationship and general knowledge of low-cost Southeast Asian tourist markets, such as Phnom Penh and similar budget tourist towns.
